items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Johnny Harmon was at the John Hotel when I was there. He was in the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Wiggs went there and recorded him. Really on his death.

Johnny Harmon was at the John Hotel when I was there. He was in the band. You been a player? I wouldn't say so. He was, I don't know. Johnny was more of an authority than I think he was a player. I really don't, I really, I was never impressed by his playing. And that's not nice for me to say. Because he's built up quite a reputation as a teacher. Maybe I'm wrong. I don't know.
